verdict.rationale: Cooley's labor and employment practice page explicitly documents that the firm represents companies and individuals in noncompete and trade secret litigation, both defending and pursuing such claims, which covers the employee-mobility and trade-secret litigation parts of the story. Confidentiality work is supported indirectly by a mutual NDA form and an IP assignment agreement included in its incorporation package. Missing for 10: a dedicated trade-secret practice page or matter metrics, any documented confidentiality-program counseling, and independent corroboration of this trade-secret work.
